verdict.rationale: The firm's Lowenstein x Clerky page covers founder stock issuances and generation of 83(b) election forms. Its pricing FAQ adds that Post-Incorporation Setup captures founder-specific vesting details and offers a managed 83(b) add-on. These are workflow and service descriptions delivered through a partner platform, not substantive firm materials explaining equity mechanics. Missing for 10: any coverage of equity splits among co-founders, explanatory content on vesting schedule design (cliffs, acceleration) and 83(b) timing or consequences, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
